conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Reinforcement learning, on the other hand, trains agents to make sequences of decisions by rewarding desired behaviors and punishing undesired ones. An example of supervised learning is predicting house prices, while grouping customers by purchasing habits is unsupervised learning.

conversation.message: That's interesting. What are some real-world applications of these different types of machine learning?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent

Reinforcement learning is applied in areas like robotics and game playing, enabling systems to learn optimal strategies through trial and error.

conversation.message: Those are great examples. How do these applications impact our daily lives?
